d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a black bow on the left side frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow lilac eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black high-low ruffled dress featuring a white chest panel, a red bow at the collar, wide white-cuffed sleeves, and black tights paired with black heeled boots. Signature details include a thin black headband with a dangling silver metallic orb and a black belt with gold triangular buckles.
